resolution.note: host wait deleted; node test args carry --test-concurrency capped by free CPUs; tests for loaded and idle hosts pass; npm run fast PASS

title: Local checks cap test concurrency to free CPUs instead of waiting for a quiet host
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: after #1429 (t-y40yzb2), every local check in `krn pr ship` and the lane final check prints `check: waiting for the host load (58.3) to fall below 16 cores, at most 600s` and idles 10 minutes: the host is shared, and other projects (phpstan, playwright, python suites) keep the 1-minute load above the core count all day, so the wait never ends early and only adds latency (ships of #1428 and #1424 ran 60-80 min).

Outcome: no local check waits for host load; instead the fast-check test phase caps its test concurrency to the free CPUs (cores minus the 1-minute load, at least 2), so tests keep their timeouts under contention; the timeout-only flake classification (rerun once, exit 78) stays.
Proof: a fast-check test with a stubbed load above the core count passes --test-concurrency=2 and with an idle host the core count; no test or caller of waitForQuietHost remains.
